newsitem.title: GERMANY: Merrill initiates SGL Carbon as "buy".
newsitem.headline: Merrill initiates SGL Carbon as "buy".

text.p: U.S. investment house Merrill Lynch said it had initiated coverage in Germany's SGL Carbon AG as a buy because of its strong position in the graphite market and the prospect of future share-buy-backs.
London-based Merrill German equities analyst Karl Debenham said the company possessed was very cash positive and had a secure market position.
"It is a unique business with an excellent, vertically-integrated global position in a high-growth, niche market," Debenham said, referring to its graphite activities.
He added that SGL Carbon had gone on record as saying it would examine the future possibility of share buy-backs.
Shares in SGL, which is also present in the carbon market, stood 10.90 marks higher at 247.0 by 0922 GMT, off an earlier reached high of 250.0.
